title.narrative: Improving safeguards to at-risk women and women survivors of gender-based domestic violence through improved protection, access to justice and reintegration in Rasht Valley of Tajikistan

description.narrative: The overall aim of the Action is to promote women¿s rights and contribute to gender equality by strengthening the self-reliance of at-risk women and women survivors of gender-based domestic violence in remote rural areas. The specific objective of the action is twofold: 1.To strengthen the protection environment for at-risk women and survivors of gender-based domestic violence in remote rural areas through improved access to justice and support services and 2: To support women affected by gender-based domestic violence to reintegrate in the society through education and social economic empowerment.
